## Why This Is Asked

This question probes system design at scale, covering data modeling, ingestion pipelines, delivery guarantees, ordering, and observability in a globally distributed, low-latency context.

## Key Concepts

- Event sourcing and durable logs (Kafka/Kinesis)
- Idempotent processing and deduplication
- Region-local vs global ordering
- Delivery guarantees (at-least-once vs exactly-once)
- Observability, testing, and chaos engineering

## Code Example

```javascript
// Example: idempotent publish wrapper
function publishAnnouncement(store, event) {
  const id = event.id;
  if (store.has(id)) return; // dedup
  store.set(id, event);
  // emit to downstream
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you design feature flags for regional rollouts and rollback strategies?
- What monitoring and tracing would you implement to detect tail latency regressions?
